'''Agoraphobia''' was an anxiety disorder that resulted in fear of open spaces and empty [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. It could manifest in several [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Ebruchi]], and [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]]. The Selonians developed agoraphobia due to their lifelong settlement in underground tunnels on the planet [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]]. The citizens of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were known to display emergent agoraphobia. Several other individuals had agoraphobia, including the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gyran]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ibtisam]], and the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Krudar]]. 

==Description==
The anxiety disorder known as agoraphobia caused a fear of open spaces and empty [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in those in which it manifested.<ref name="Sisar" /> Individuals who had agoraphobia were known as "agoraphobic."<ref name="Ibtisam" /> Several [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] could be afflicted by agoraphobia, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="Sisar" /> [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]],<ref name="Ibtisam" /> [[Duros/Legends|Duros]],<ref name="Kathol" /> [[Ebruchi]],<ref name="TUR" /> and [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]]. Agoraphobia, ranging from mild to noticeable,<ref name="Core" /> was common in Selonians, as they spent the majority of their life in intricate underground tunnels on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> As such, Selonians disliked outer [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="SDAC">''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''</ref> In contrast, many generations of the Ebruchi spending [[Time/Legends|time]] in space was, in fact, the cause for a mild agoraphobia in members of the species.<ref name="TUR" /> The attachment of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] species to their<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Colonist/Legends|colony]]<ref name="EV">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref> world of [[Muunilinst]] was believed to render them near-agoraphobic.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==History==
===Before and during the Imperial era===
By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="SH-Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> many [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-high apartment buildings on<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Core" /> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] housed many indoor amenities such as living quarters, [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponic]] [[Garden/Legends|gardens]], and parks. The inhabitants of those habitats, who rarely ventured outside, had emergent agoraphobia.<ref name="Shadow Hunter" /> Two notable Selonian individuals with agoraphobia were [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Shaclor]] for the [[Chanzari Den]], a [[Den (Selonian)|den]] on Selonia, and the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] [[Magalak]] who resided on the world [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="Core" />

[[File:Ibtisam_shotdown.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ibtisam's starship was shot down above Endor, an event which would leave her adrift in space and agoraphobic.]]
The Human [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gyran]] had developed a mild form of agoraphobia by<ref name="Sisar" /> some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="SisarDate">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]'', which includes "[[The Barani Conspiracy]]," is set after {{Film|IV}} but prior to the conclusion of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'' novel]], which corresponds to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> It manifested during a [[Skirmish in the underwater caves|mission]] to<ref name="Sisar" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEAOC Sedri">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sedri system/Legends|Sedri system]]</ref> planet [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] to retrieve the [[Barani List]],<ref name="Sisar" /> a compilation of [[operative]]s of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Guri">{{DB|droid|guri|Guri}}</ref> Gyran found the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] intimidating but felt more comfortable in its [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Cave/Legends|caves]].<ref name="Sisar" />

In 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ibtisam]] fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]].<ref name="Handbook1">[[Star Wars Handbook 1: X-Wing Rogue Squadron|''Star Wars Handbook'' 1: ''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> During the second oncoming wave of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], Ibtisam's [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] was shot down. The Mon Calamari ejected from her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and drifted aimlessly in space for twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] until she was rescued. The event left her agoraphobic; however, her agoraphobia could be contained while within the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a ship.<ref name="Ibtisam" />

===Post-Imperial era===
The Duros [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Krudar]] and his fellow crew aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' passed through the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]],<ref name="Kathol" /> in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the Outer Rim,<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TKR-Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[The Kathol Rift]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> The area, which was known to amplify the effects of mental disorders, greatly intensified Krudar's agoraphobia, which caused him to remain in his quarters in fear. When exiting his quarters, Krudar saw the ship's corridors extending to an infinite degree.<ref name="Kathol" />

In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]],<ref name="Dracmus-Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[Assault at Selonia]]'' and ''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]'' to [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]].</ref> the Selonian rebel [[Dracmus]] and the Human New Republic [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were imprisoned in the same cell of a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] operated by the [[Human League]] group on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and successfully escaped from the planet in tandem.<ref name="AaS">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref> The two subsequently attempted to land the primitive [[Selonian cone ship]] they were traveling in onto the surface of Selonia with the intent to resolve the disputes between the rebellious Selonian [[Hunchuzuc Den]] and the radicalist [[Overden]]. With Dracmus in command of the vessel, Solo began to repair the ship in order to prepare for [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] re-entry. As the ship neared the atmosphere and Solo began to rush the repairs, Dracmus started to panic due to an onset of agoraphobia and was instructed by the captain to be patient.<ref name="SDAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agoraphobia first appeared in the [[1995]] novel ''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]'', written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]] as the third entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy]]''.<ref name="SDAC" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Agoraphobia|agoraphobia]] is an [[Wikipedia:Anxiety disorder|anxiety disorder]].<ref name="Mayo">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/agoraphobia/symptoms-causes/syc-20355987|text=Agoraphobia - Symptoms and causes|work=[[Wikipedia:Mayo Clinic|Mayo Clinic]]|archivedate=20230604091320}}</ref>
